jobs.description:
Do you want to earn a top salary? As a warehouse employee at DPD in Meppel, you can earn up to € 22,49 per hour with bonuses! We are looking for a motivated warehouse employee who loves short shifts, and plenty of free time during the day. Whether you want to work part-time or full-time, the choice is yours! Read on, and see what else we offer!

What we offer
- A great base hourly wage of € 14,99 (18+)
- 45% allowance before 06:00 AM (€ 21,74 per hour)
- € 22,49 per hour on Saturdays (50% extra!)
- Friendly colleagues from all over the world
- Travel allowance starting from 10 kilometers
- Join a team with a working environment rated 8+

Who you are
You don’t mind rolling up your sleeves. As a warehouse employee, you see every shift as a workout! Further, you meet the following points:

- You are 18 years or older due to safety and night shift regulations
- You have your own car to reach the location in Meppel
- You speak and understand the English or Dutch language
- You are available for at least 2 days a week
- You are physically able to lift packages and deal with roll containers

What will you do
As a warehouse employee you are the heartbeat of our logistic process. You load and unload trucks at a good pace. This gives a great feeling of accomplishment when the job is done. Together with your team, you will sort and scan every package. The parcels will reach the customers on time with your help. Because the shifts are 5.5 hours, you stay energized and the time flies by. Work done!

- Afternoon shift: Monday to Friday from 16:00 to 21:30
- Night shift: Tuesday to Saturday from 02:00 to 07:30

Where will you work
Step into the energetic world of DPD in Meppel! Here, you join a friendly, international team. Working together feels like a team sport and the atmosphere scores a solid 8+! 🌟 As a logistics employee, you are part of a warm community.

Exciting news: DPD is planning to move to Zwolle in November (though staying in Meppel is still possible). Got a car?
